title: The chosen display is kept after sign-out, on other devices and locations
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. User has access to at least two locations and can log in on a second device/browser.
custom_steps:
1. Choose Board View on the Work Orders page.
  2. Log out and log back in; open Work Orders.
  3. Log in on a second device/browser; open Work Orders.
  4. Change to another location and open Work Orders.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Your chosen display is remembered and comes back after logging out and in, on another device, and at another location.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S1-R4 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “Save the selected display option per user. It follows the user after logout/login, on other devices, and in other locations.”
